notes.title: Pristiq: Tash's Trilogy Has Been Released!
notes.notes:
Pristiq: Tash's Trilogy Has Been Released!

This Game Was a Journey, a Start of One.
This Game Helped Me Battle My Problems and Gave Me Something to Do, Instead of Worrying Too Much About What Am I Going to Do Tomorrow.

It All Started as an Idea with My Friend Daniel and Elias and 1 Year 1 Month and 13 Days After This Is the Result. from No Idea How to Make a Game We Made Something, It May Not Be Perfect but We Did It!

This Game Changed My Life and It's Going to Be Weird Waking Up Tomorrow and Not Thinking About What Am I Going to Add and Fix in the Game.

I'm Sure We'll Look Back at This Game One Day with a Smile

-Amir Dayyef
